request.description: Accepts the specified transaction delivery. This link is included when a Transaction is retrieved from a Inbox or via an Inbound HTTP Communication Channel.If this Delivery is the most recent one associated with a Transaction, this will update the Transaction's `deliveryStatus` to `DELIVERED`.If this Delivery is associated with one or more Transactions in a inbox, this will also remove the Transactions from that inbox.

request.description:
Fails the specified transaction delivery. This link is included when a Transaction is retrieved from a Inbox or via an Inbound HTTP Communication Channel.

If this Delivery is the most recent one associated with a Transaction, this will update the Transaction's `deliveryStatus` to `FAILED`.

If this Delivery is associated with one or more Transactions in a inbox, this will also remove the Transactions from that inbox.
